paragraphs: And his daughter Shlomtziyon the queen, wife of King Yannai, as explained in their entries.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “His daughter” refers to Shetach, the heading name; Shlomtziyon is thus Shimon ben Shetach’s sister.

The whole William Davidson Berakhot 48a paragraph explicitly calls Shimon ben Shetach the brother of Yannai’s wife. It supports the sibling and marital directions in the current note; the paragraph does not give the queen’s personal name. Shlomtziyon and the daughter-of-Shetach wording remain Hyman’s account under this heading, with the current note verbatim. This is no new authority or genealogy binding and imports no surrounding narrative.
